detailed_descriptions.en: Guns, guns, guns! The only thing better is guns that put out more bullets! Which is exactly what you get with the Houston Breakout Weapon Pack , three burstfire weapons slinging lead in 3-round bursts. Primary Chanit S3 - A rapid burstfire beast able to throw multiple shots down range in the blink of an eye. M7 Pursuivant - Compact and deadly, this burstfire shotgun will accurately discharge three shells in under a second. Secondary Picchio Duro 5 - A burstfire secondary for a quick draw and even quicker shot. The pack also comes with the Free Country Charm and the Gavel Sticker .

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Guns, guns, guns! The only thing better is guns that put out more bullets! Which is exactly what you get with the Houston Breakout Weapon Pack, three burstfire weapons slinging lead in 3-round bursts.

Primary

  • Chanit S3 - A rapid burstfire beast able to throw multiple shots down range in the blink of an eye.

  • M7 Pursuivant - Compact and deadly, this burstfire shotgun will accurately discharge three shells in under a second.

Secondary

  • Picchio Duro 5 - A burstfire secondary for a quick draw and even quicker shot.

The pack also comes with the Free Country Charm and the Gavel Sticker.
